sharedImplementation: Browser-service to and extension fc share protocol methods but preserve their distinct transport-field initialization order. Core extraction and factory are project refactoring boundaries. Request-header template parsing and expansion are shared between browser VC/u5 and extension cs/ls via project-created @core/core/requestHeaders. Host/origin normalization and matching now share @core/core/originPatterns; differential tests compare the extension ic/up/gp closure.
composition: createExtensionBrowserFoundation shares identity, leases, groups, favicons/content readiness, observed-tabs/overlay, debugger, tab and network-policy state across restored handler/sessions. Overlay and favicons share one content runtime. Observed-tab initialization and runtime message listener registration remain caller responsibilities. Observed-tab audio muting/restore branches are now composed, and session background muting uses the same controller. Full dR startup is still incomplete. Foreign-frame monitor is created once when handler-class dependencies become available, using the supplied original-derived browser-family/internal-URL helpers (brave override false, matching Jt(userAgent)). Handler initializes it; sessions share track/ensure/remove with the lease/content runtime. Popup interceptor is now shared by handlers/sessions, with the original-derived lease/content runtime; foundation exposes its guarded message route. Full runtime listener chain remains startup work.
